newsitem.title: UK: Aerodata says ups interest in S. Pickford.
newsitem.headline: Aerodata says ups interest in S. Pickford.

text.p: Aerodata Holdings said on Tuesday it had acquired another 46,000 shares in Scott Pickford Plc for 55 pence per share raising its interest in 3,020,907 shares representing 23.91 percent in the British oil services firm.
A British court had ruled on Tuesday that Aerodata and Scott must go ahead with a proposed share swap that was announced in December, 1996.

According to the share swap deal, Aerodata was scheduled to buy 2.5 million of Scott Pickford's shares which would have given it a 20 percent stake in the current share capital of the British Company.
Scott was to be offered 1.873 million shares in Aerodata at A$ 0.50 each ammounting to 4.3 percent of the current issued capital.
Aerodata is fighting U.S.-based laboratory services group Core Laboratories NV for control of Scott Pickford.
The share swap has become a focus of the takeover tussle after Core raised its bid for Scott to 59 pence per share on condition that the swap does not take place.
Core's increased offer values Pickford at around 7.5 million stg.
